newsitem.title: USA: American Healthcorp says to report Q4 gain.
newsitem.headline: American Healthcorp says to report Q4 gain.

text.p: American Healthcorp Inc said Thursday the company will report a fourth-quarter gain of $0.09 per share, or $760,000, in net income, largely because of issues it has resolved with the Internal Revenue Service.

Chairman and Chief Executive Thomas Cigarran said in a statement that the gain was the result of being able to resolve all issues principally relating to the deductibility of costs associated with the leveraged buyout of the company in 1988 and the sale of the company's alcohol and drug treatment unit in 1989.
Two years ago, the company filed a petition in the United States Tax Court, contesting an IRS proposed rejection of deductions associated with those issues.
A settlement was recently reached with the IRS, which American Healthcorp said essentially confirmed the company's position on those issues.
Accordingly, the company reversed $760,000 of income tax liability reserves previously provided for those matters.
American Healthcorp provides specialized services for people with diabetes.
